verdict: Paid ads have been dark for 25 days; Google presence is now fading too.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Meta campaigns spent $57.43 in total but have not run since September 15, leaving paid lead generation effectively off for the past 25+ days. At the same time, your Google Business Profile — which had been a reliable source of local actions — dropped 63.64% in week-over-week activity, with the last three days of the period showing near-zero engagement. Your CRM shows 9 opportunities from 171 contacts this period, but none have converted or booked, pointing to a gap between interest and intake. Reactivating paid campaigns and shoring up local profile visibility are both in motion now. Next period, you should see ad activity resume and GBP engagement stabilize as those steps take effect.
